answer: A farm that floods the queue early hence gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Because the atlas ordering is published with the onyx batch, the meadow audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 45% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A 54 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
